findings.title: Defining a Clinically Meaningful Within-Person Change Threshold for the Psychomotor Vigilance Test in Narcolepsy Type 1 (Ther Innov Regul Sci)
findings.whatChanged: Analysis of the two phase 3 trials (The First Light n=166, The Radiant Light n=105): 66.9% vs 25.7% and 57.6% vs 17.6% achieved meaningful attention improvement vs placebo. Names the phase 3 trials explicitly — the dossier previously carried fabricated trial names for this compound, so use these verified names.
